title: Pure Bounzer
summary: Bounzer is a Level 6 Warrior and Rank 6 Xyz archetype played by Nistro in Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL. Centered around the iconic Rank 6 Photon Strike Bounzer and normal-summonable Level 6 Hammer Bounzer, the deck uses Cyber Tutubon and Parry Knights to swarm Level 6 Warriors and lock down opposing monster effects.

allow.Spell Striker: Special Summons itself by banishing a Spell from the GY without leaving a Spell/Trap on the field, providing Tribute fodder for Bounzers.
allow.Cyber Tutubon: Level 5 EARTH Warrior that Special Summons itself from the hand by Tributing a Warrior or Fairy.
allow.Performapal Handsamuraiger: Level 6 Warrior that protects Bounzer monsters or acts as Level 6 Rank 6 material.
allow.The Monarchs Stormforth: Tributes an opponent's monster to Normal Summon Hammer Bounzer, Phantom Bounzer, or Blade Bounzer.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Searches Bounzer Guard or Blade Bounzer.
allow.Parry Knights: Level 6 EARTH Warrior that Special Summons itself when you take battle damage to facilitate Rank 6 plays.
allow.Bound Wand: Equips to a Spellcaster or Warrior to revive it when destroyed by an opponent's card.
allow.Number 24: Dragulas the Vampiric Dragon: Rank 6 Xyz made with two Level 6 Bounzers that flips opposing monsters face-down and sends cards to the GY.
allow.Gauntlet Launcher: Rank 6 Warrior Xyz made with two Level 6 Bounzers that detaches materials to destroy opposing monsters.
allow.Evolzar Lars: Rank 6 Xyz made with two Level 6 Bounzers that provides omni-negation.

main: Hammer Bounzer
Level 6 Warrior with 2300 ATK that can be Normal Summoned without Tributing if the opponent controls a card and you control no cards.
Phantom Bounzer
Level 6 Warrior with 2400 ATK that searches any 2 'Bounzer' cards from the Deck when sent from the field to the GY.
Blade Bounzer
Level 4 Warrior that discards a card after attacking an opponent's monster to make a second attack on a monster.
Bounzer Guard
Level 1 Tuner that targets a Bounzer monster to protect it from battle/card destruction and forces opponents to attack that Bounzer.
Spell Striker
Banishes a Spell from the GY to Special Summon itself, leaving your field clear of Spells/Traps for Hammer Bounzer's attack effect.
Cyber Tutubon
Tributes Phantom Bounzer from hand or field to Special Summon itself and trigger Phantom Bounzer's double search.
Performapal Handsamuraiger
Level 6 Warrior that tributes a monster to gain ATK and pairs with Hammer/Phantom Bounzer for Rank 6 plays.
The Monarchs Stormforth
Lets you Tribute an opponent's monster to Tribute Summon Phantom Bounzer or Hammer Bounzer.
Reinforcement of the Army
Searches Blade Bounzer, Bounzer Guard, or Spell Striker.
Bound Wand
Equips to a monster and revives it when destroyed.
Parry Knights
Level 6 EARTH Warrior that Special Summons itself when you take battle damage to enable instant Rank 6 plays.
extra: Signature Rank 6 Xyz boss that detaches 1 material to negate any monster effect on the opponent's field and inflict 1000 burn damage.
Rank 6 Warrior Xyz that detaches 1 material up to twice per turn to destroy an opponent's monster.
Rank 6 Xyz that flips Special Summoned monsters face-down as a Quick Effect.
Rank 6 Xyz that detaches 1 material to negate the effects of any face-up card the opponent controls.
